items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: he played with that band and played with Ory's band at that time, and I knew of him, you know, see.

ctx.x: And who was that? Do you know who was in there? Who had the band?
He was playing with Ory too at that time, you know, when he was playing out there.
I just remember who was playing with him. I don't know who had the band, did you hear? No, I don't remember all that.
